items.title: ［キャリアクエスト］先輩から引き継がれる開発ノウハウ。ラセングルの新進気鋭プランナーが語る，ゲーム開発の最前線【PR】

items.title: 「EA SPORTS UFC 6」，拡張パック「PRIDE FC」を12月12日に配信。桜庭，ミルコ，ヒョードルらが登場するトレイラーも公開に

en.title: The sequel to the side-scrolling action game "ICEY" that incorporates meta elements, "After ICEY," is scheduled to be released on May 1, 2027. Approximately 1,024 million yen was raised through the Kurafan project that ended today.
en.summary: Crowdfunding for ``AfterICEY'' (Ai Xi: 续), the sequel to the 2D side-scrolling action ``ICEY'', ended today. With the support of approximately 260,000 people, we raised approximately 42.81 million yuan (approximately 1.024 billion yen), far exceeding the target amount. This work is scheduled to be released on May 1, 2027.

en.title: The same "Shadow Blade Zero", Douyin players play in different arenas

On the eve of the official release of "Shadow Blade Zero" on October 29th, you can easily see memes like this on Douyin. As another domestic game that has attracted attention at home and abroad after "Black Myth: Wukong", "Shadow Blade Zero" has attracted much attention before its launch with its distinctive "kung fu punk" aesthetics and the blend of Hong Kong-style action movie textures. After its launch, it also ignited the circle of single-console gamers without much suspense. However, when ordinary players are still swimming around in the shadow world and fighting bosses in Shuangtantu, if you open Douyin, you will find some unexpected tricks happening on the already lively platform: someone created a MOD to turn the map into an "electronic cricket fight" arena, allowing two powerful bosses to fight each other on the same field; there are also actors and actresses with real face models of the core characters in the game personally appearing in front of the screen.

ja.title: Station B の新作はクリスマスイブに予定: なぜ SLG トラックに「キングダム」が必要なのか?
ja.summary: ■はじめに 11月14日、Chuleは広州で開催された『Three Kingdoms: The King's Way of the World』（以下、『三王』）のオフライン試食会に参加しました。会議では、Bilibili ゲーム パブリッシング責任者の Song Ci 氏が、ゲームが 12 月 24 日に正式にリリースされると発表しました。数年前、私は SLG ゲーム コンテンツのコミュニティ構築作業に参加しました。このトラックのゲームは、外部の世界に宣伝するときに、プレイヤーに見合ったものであることを証明するために、特定の「スタイル」を示す必要があることがよくあります。現段階では「スリーキングス」も同様のことを行っている。例えば、「第21回玄奘路ビジネススクールゴビチャレンジ」の唯一のゲームパートナーでもある。世界的に有名なビジネススクールが主な参加者となる持久ウォーキング大会です。ビジネスエリートたちがゴビロードで体力、意志力、意思決定能力の限界に挑戦します。これが彼らがプレイヤーにもたらしたいもののようです。試食セッション中に、Song Ci 氏は Duan Yihong がゲーム ブランドの広報担当者になったというニュースも発表しました。

en.title: Station B’s new work is scheduled for Christmas Eve: Why does the SLG track need “kingdom”?
en.summary: ■ Introduction On November 14, Chule participated in the offline tasting event of "Three Kingdoms: The King's Way of the World" (hereinafter referred to as "Three Kings") held in Guangzhou. At the meeting, Mr. Song Ci, the head of Bilibili game publishing, announced that the game will be officially released on December 24. A few years ago, I participated in some SLG game content community building work. Games in this track often need to show a certain "style" when promoting to the outside world to prove that they are commensurate with players. At this stage, "Three Kings" is also doing similar things. For example, it is the only game partner of the "21st Xuanzang Road Business School Gobi Challenge". This is an endurance walking competition with world-renowned business schools as the main participants. Business elites challenge the limits of physical strength, willpower and decision-making ability on the Gobi Road. It seems like this is what they want to bring to players. During the tasting session, Mr. Song Ci also announced the news that Duan Yihong has become the spokesperson of the game brand.

items.title: Gadio Spec《博尔赫斯 迷宫与顿悟》试听集
items.summary: 你着迷的是迷宫还是顿悟？溯白银之河而上，踩碎印第安泪。失明的图书馆长说，所有太阳，沉睡在恒河的尽头。曼妙的探戈舞步，是豹的身影。高乔牛仔的刀锋寒光闪过，划破夜的寂静。这一切都是神谕里无解的谜。永恒中，你只能全部接受。在另一个时空，阿根廷没时间哭泣，因为它已经迷失。是遗忘、爱和犹疑的手，主宰着那个封闭的世界，如同一个梦。本期SPEC节目，为介绍这位神奇的作家做挂一漏万的开题，引你进入出人意料的文学世界。

ja.title: ガディオスペック「ボルヘスの迷宮と公現」試聴集
ja.summary: あなたは迷路に魅了されますか、それともひらめきに魅了されますか?銀の川を遡り、インディアンの涙を砕きなさい。盲目の図書館司書は、「すべての太陽はガンジス川の端で眠っている」と言いました。優雅なタンゴダンスのステップはまさにヒョウの姿。ガウチョ・カウボーイの刃の冷たい光が夜の静寂を切り裂いて閃いた。これらはすべて神託では解けない謎です。永遠に、あなたはすべてを受け入れることしかできません。別の時空では、アルゼンチンはそれを失って泣く暇もなかった。夢のような閉ざされた世界を支配するのは、忘却と愛と迷いの手。このSPECプログラムは、多くの質問とともにこの素晴らしい作家を紹介し、あなたを予期せぬ文学の世界へと導きます。

en.title: Gadio Spec "Borges' Labyrinth and Epiphany" audition collection
en.summary: Are you fascinated by the maze or the epiphany? Go up the silver river and crush the Indian tears. The blind librarian said that all the suns sleep at the end of the Ganges. The graceful tango dance steps are the figure of a leopard. The cold light of the gaucho cowboy's blade flashed, cutting through the silence of the night. All these are unsolvable mysteries in the oracle. In eternity, you can only accept it all. In another time and space, Argentina had no time to cry because it was lost. It is the hands of forgetfulness, love and hesitation that dominate that closed world, like a dream. This SPEC program will introduce you to this amazing writer with a lot of questions and lead you into an unexpected world of literature.

items.title: 《巴别图书馆》：世界是一本无限的书，放在无穷的图书馆中 | 博尔赫斯 迷宫与顿悟 Vol.1

ja.summary: この号のタイムライン制作: アジ 私たちはボルヘスの小説の迷宮に正式に入りました。まずは彼の短編小説『バベルの図書館』について話しましょう。パズルゲームのように複雑なボルヘスの小説の複雑な相互参照と比喩を簡単に体験した後、ボルヘスがこの小説で夢中になっていた概念の 1 つである無限について触れます。すべてのテキストをカバーする図書館の迷路をさまよってみてください。考えてみれば、私たちはシェイクスピアのすべての作品をキーボードで入力しようとしている単なる猿かもしれません。このプログラムは単なる奇妙なガイド、ねじれた松葉杖です。しかし実際には、私たちは道に迷うためにここにいます。なぜなら、ひらめきは実際に私たちの後ろを追っていて、私たちが引き返すことを期待していないからです。レガート・コン・アモーレ・イン・アンヴォリューム、自然の世界にふさわしい詩

en.title: "The Library of Babel": The world is an infinite book placed in an infinite library | Borges Labyrinth and Epiphany Vol.1
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Adji We have officially entered the labyrinth in Borges's novel. As a start, let's talk about his short story "The Library of Babel". After briefly experiencing the complex cross-references and metaphors of Borges's novels, which are as complex as puzzle games, we will touch on one of the concepts that Borges was obsessed with in this novel: infinity. Try wandering through the maze of libraries that cover all texts, and come to think of it, maybe we are just monkeys trying to type out all the works of Shakespeare on our keyboards. en.title: "Doomsday Gun": The art director of "Half-Life 2" died young, leaving behind a soul-like FPS legacy
en.summary: “Viktor’s work is unique,” ​​said Helene Giraud, art director of Guns of Eschaton. “He has a very distinct personal style that no one can imitate.” As many fans of the late artist know, Viktor Antonov’s work is both fantastical and realistic. In games such as "Half-Life 2" and "Dishonored" that Antonov participated in the development of during his lifetime, his works were always perfectly integrated with the gameplay mechanisms, so that he could support various seemingly absurd and bizarre settings with realistic underlying logic. "Armageddon" displays Antonov's iconic dark art style with a grotesque image of a western cowboy. Viktor Antonov is a world-renowned game artist. He once used his skillful hands to create City 17 in "Half-Life 2" and the city of Dunwall in "Dishonored".

en.summary: Tu Le talks at night, talking nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Picture / Ronaldinho For some time, I have found that the commercial products on the market are increasingly unable to meet my needs. Especially when it comes to women. As an older (I dare not say senior) long-term and stable consumer of female-oriented products, I have tried them all, from the earliest stand-alone Japanese games to the later female-oriented mobile games, to the AI ​​companion products that have emerged in the past few years. There were those who were very satisfied at one time, and there were also those who were "set up" by various outrageous operations and were forced to quit. But no matter what the pain point AFK is, the final reason can mostly be attributed to one thing. I do have a certain need for emotional companionship, but this need has little to do with the traditional or stereotyped standard "virtual love". My home is in a small southern border town. Here, summer is always very long, and the hot days severely squeeze the time in spring and autumn.
